title: 第1493章 巫族复出第1492章 巫族准备搬家
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: “师尊，现在地府的人都来天竺国了！”
“这是不给你们面子啊！”
面对两位圣人，湿婆神跪在地上哭着说道。
当然他并没有离开神庙，而是打开了一道圆光镜。
“阴差的事情我们已经知道了！”
“这件事情，你们最好不要多管闲事！”
接引圣人头痛地说道。
前不久，后土使用无上神力打败了天道，将地道升华。
现在可以说是风头无量。
现在的地道已经可以和天道抗衡了。
后土娘娘和鸿钧老祖之间谁强谁弱还不好说。
没必要为了一些阴差的事情得罪后土娘娘。
“可是，之前玉皇大帝说过，天庭是不会插手天竺国的事情的！”
毗湿奴同样开口说道。
“当年玉皇大帝就是这样承诺，可是现在的天庭管不了地府！”
准提圣人提醒说道。
地府已经脱离掌控了，是从地道升华以后，没有人可以管得了地府了。
“我警告你们不要去招惹后土圣人！”
“现在的后土圣人应该是除了师尊以外最强的存在了！”
接引圣人愤怒的说道。
那必须先敲打一下这三个家伙。
以免对方招惹到了后土圣人。
“可是银钗来天竺国……”
毗湿奴还想再说什么，就被接引圣人粗暴的打断了。
“后土圣人对我等西方之人向来苛责！”
“你们要是招惹到了后土圣人，就用你们的鲜血，来平息圣人的怒火。”
准提圣人开口说道。
现在如果不敲打一下这三大古神，迟早会惹出麻烦来。
“师尊，我等知错了，还请不要发火。”
梵天大神，立刻求饶说道。
“弟子等人告退！”
随后三人立刻撤去了圆光术。
“希望他们三人不要惹出事端来！”
接引圣人叹了一口气说道。
就在此时，一道倩影出现在了虚拟山顶。
来者不是别人，正是后土圣人。
接引瞬间回头看去。
看到了后土圣人，心中只是一惊。
content_en:
"Master, now everyone from the underworld has come to Tianzhu!"
"This doesn't give you face!"
Facing the two saints, Lord Shiva knelt on the ground and cried.
Of course, he did not leave the temple, but opened a circular light mirror.
"We already know about the sinister thing!"
"You'd better not meddle in this matter!"
The saint said with a headache.
Not long ago, Hou Tu used his supreme divine power to defeat the Heavenly Dao and sublimate the Earthly Dao.
Now it can be said that it is extremely popular.
The current tunnel can compete with the heaven.
It’s hard to say who is stronger and who is weaker between Empress Houtu and Patriarch Hongjun.
There is no need to offend the Queen Mother for some shady things.
"But, the Jade Emperor said before that Heaven will not interfere in the affairs of Tianzhu Kingdom!"
Vishnu also spoke.
"This is what the Jade Emperor promised back then, but now heaven cannot control the underworld!"
Saint Zhunti reminded.
The underworld is out of control. After sublimating from the tunnel, no one can control the underworld.
"I warn you not to provoke Saint Houtu!"
"The current Saint Houtu should be the strongest existence besides Master!"
The saint said angrily.
Then we must knock these three guys first.
In order to prevent the other party from provoking the Houtu Saint.
"But Yinchai came to Tianzhu..."
Vishnu wanted to say something more, but was rudely interrupted by the saint.
"Sage Houtu has always been harsh on us and other Westerners!"
"If you offend Saint Houtu, use your blood to appease the saint's anger."
Saint Zhunti said.
If we don't beat these three ancient gods now, they will cause trouble sooner or later.
"Master, I know I was wrong, so please don't get angry."
Lord Brahma immediately begged for mercy.
"Disciple and others resign!"
Then the three of them immediately removed the round light technique.
"I hope the three of them won't cause any trouble!"
The saint said with a sigh.
At this moment, a beautiful figure appeared on the virtual mountaintop.
The person who came was none other than Saint Houtu.
He looked back instantly.
When I saw Houtu Saint, I was just shocked.
